Question: Forge exact-head run on b2ef77f: fmt 0, build 0, 895/898 pass, 1 FAIL. `root_positive_query_does_not_open_registered_sources` (snapshot.rs:13329, untouched by the patch) asserts the OLD cold refusal: prepare_graph over 929 registered ids must return `incomplete` with 0 discovery entries. On-demand now returns `ok`, discovery 930, source_opens 0. CI swift (now in_progress) runs the same suite and will fail the same way, so b2ef77f cannot pass the merge gate as-is. The rest of that test (warm page, 0-discovery prepare, root-positive query with no source opens, 1 disk write) still holds its point. Stopped per your order. Which test-only amendment do I ship and re-verify on forge?
Options: A: assert on-demand contract (Recommended) | B: drop the cold prepare block | Hold: root reviews the full log first
